switches.name: Blur
switches.tip: Blurs a source and clears it again. The key shows which way it is.

switches.name: Shadow, Glow & Outline
switches.tip: Switches a source's shadow, glow or outline on and off.

switches.name: Corners & Edges
switches.tip: Switches a source's shaped corners and edges on and off.

switches.name: Zoom
switches.tip: Zooms a source in and back out.

switches.name: Auto Capture
switches.tip: Switches automatic game capture on and off. On hands a hooked capture back to it.

switches.name: Auto Frame
switches.tip: Switches a capture's automatic framing on and off.

switches.name: Standby Picture
switches.tip: Switches the picture shown while nothing is captured on and off.

switches.name: Show in Scenes
switches.tip: Shows and hides sources across scenes with one switch.

switches.name: Fit to Space
switches.tip: Switches a scene's fitting of its game or window on and off.

switches.name: Follow Active App
switches.tip: Switches following the app in use on and off.

switches.name: Program Trigger
switches.tip: Switches a program trigger on and off.

switches.name: Link Visibility
switches.tip: Switches a link between items' visibility on and off.

switches.name: Show/Hide Animation
switches.tip: Switches a scene's show and hide animations on and off.

moves.name: Move Source
moves.tip: Sends the camera, or any source, to one of its saved places.

moves.name: Move Scene Item
moves.tip: Moves a scene's item to its place.

moves.name: Apply Layout
moves.tip: Puts a scene's items into a saved layout.
